job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
Solutions Architect

Fixed-Term Contract | Wellington | Hybrid Working

Are you a Solutions Architect who enjoys turning business strategy into practical, scalable technology outcomes?

We're looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to join a high-performing team and play a key role in the delivery of a significant programme of work. This is an opportunity to shape solution design, influence technology decisions, and work closely with stakeholders across business and technology functions.

About the Role

As the Solutions Architect, you'll be responsible for designing end-to-end solutions that align with business objectives, technology standards, and enterprise architecture principles. You'll work closely with delivery teams, technical specialists, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are robust, secure, and fit for purpose.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and documenting solution architectures across multiple technology domains
  • Translating business requirements into practical technical solutions
  • Providing architectural leadership throughout project delivery
  • Ensuring solutions meet security, integration, scalability, and operational requirements
  • Collaborating with architects, delivery leads, engineers, and business stakeholders
  • Supporting technology governance and design assurance processes
  • Contributing to technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives

About You

You'll be an experienced Solutions Architect with a strong track record delivering complex technology initiatives in large and diverse environments.

You'll bring:

  • Proven experience in a Solutions Architect role
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application, integration, data, and cloud architectures
  • Experience working across complex transformation or technology delivery programmes
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with practical delivery outcomes
  • Experience producing architecture artefacts, standards, and solution design documentation
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, modern integration approaches, and security best practices

What's on Offer?

  • Wellington-based role with hybrid working arrangements
  • Fixed-term opportunity on a significant programme of work
  • Exposure to complex and high-profile technology initiatives
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Competitive remuneration package

If you're a Solutions Architect looking for your next challenge and want to play a key role in delivering meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Test Engineer | Fixed Term Contract | 18months

Are you a hands-on Test Engineer who enjoys building robust automation frameworks, validating complex data, and ensuring critical systems perform as expected?

We're looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join a major transformation programme where you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality outcomes across banking and financial services products. This is an opportunity to work on complex integrations, data migrations, and API-driven solutions in a collaborative, delivery-focused environment.

What you'll be doing
As a Test Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated testing solutions that ensure systems are reliable, accurate, and fit for purpose. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, developers, and delivery teams to validate business requirements, improve test coverage, and support successful releases.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Building and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites
  • Designing and executing API, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Validating complex business rules, calculations, and financial transactions
  • Performing migration and reconciliation testing across source and target systems
  • Querying and analysing data to validate outcomes and identify discrepancies
  • Supporting SIT and E2E testing activities, including defect triage and troubleshooting
  • Contributing to CI/CD pipelines and continuous quality practices
  • Ensuring clear traceability between requirements, test scenarios, and automation coverage
What you'll bring
We're looking for someone with strong technical testing capability combined with experience working in financial services or banking environments.
You'll ideally have:
  • Strong experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Postman, Bruno, NUnit/C#, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, or Karate
  • Solid programming skills in Java and/or Python
  • Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs, including JSON and XML validation
  • Strong SQL and database querying skills
  • Experience using Git and modern version control practices
  • A proven track record delivering automation within CI/CD environments such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions
  • Strong troubleshooting and defect investigation skills
Highly desirable experience
  • Banking, financial services, lending, payments, or core banking platforms
  • Data-driven testing approaches and parameterised automation frameworks
  • Data migration, reconciliation, and validation testing
  • Testing financial calculations, interest accruals, fees, or transaction processing
  • BDD frameworks and tools such as Gherkin or Cucumber
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

Key Skills
Test Automation | Playwright | Postman | Selenium | Cypress | API Testing | Python | Java | SQL | Git | CI/CD | Jenkins | GitHub Actions | Data Migration | Reconciliation Testing | Banking | Financial Services | BDD | Cucumber | Gherkin

job.title: Solution Architect - Oracle
job.description:
Permanent Opportunity

Wellington, Auckland or Christchurch

About the Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to join a high-performing technology and delivery team. This role offers the opportunity to utilise your solution architecture expertise to design and guide technology solutions that support large-scale business transformation initiatives, improve user experiences, and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

Working within a collaborative architecture practice, you will play a key role in shaping technology direction, evaluating emerging trends, and ensuring solutions are aligned with enterprise standards, strategic objectives, and long-term sustainability.

About the Role
As a Solution Architect, you will provide expert advice and technical leadership across a diverse portfolio of initiatives. You will analyse technology trends, assess solution options, and design architecture that supports business change while maintaining a secure, scalable and sustainable technology landscape.

Working closely with Enterprise, Business and Technical Architects, you will help ensure solutions are delivered coherently and align with broader technology roadmaps and architectural principles.

Key Responsibilities
  • Contribute architecture expertise to the design and implementation of enterprise technology solutions.
  • Evaluate and recommend solution options, technologies and delivery approaches.
  • Apply knowledge of data, information and technology trends, standards and best practices to guide architectural direction.
  • Design solutions across areas including ERP, payroll, finance and accounting platforms while ensuring compliance with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Support the development and ongoing maintenance of technology roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure and platform teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade solutions.
  • Provide architectural oversight and guidance throughout project delivery.
  • Support solution governance and ensure alignment with strategic business objectives.

About You
You are an innovative and forward-thinking Solution Architect who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing positive change. You bring strong technical capability, excellent stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to coach and mentor others.

You'll Bring
  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect within a large and complex organisation.
  • Strong experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, including ERP and EPM platforms.
  • Experience leading ERP, data and information architecture initiatives.
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies including SaaS, PaaS and IaaS environments.
  • Exposure to payroll, finance, procurement or enterprise business systems.
  • Experience working with, or supporting, AI-enabled initiatives is advantageous.
  • A strong understanding of current and emerging technology trends.
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and navigate governance and decision-making processes.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills.

Why Apply?
This is an opportunity to join a large-scale enterprise environment where you can contribute to strategic technology initiatives, influence future architecture direction, and work alongside experienced architecture and delivery professionals.

If you're passionate about designing practical, scalable solutions and enjoy working in a collaborative and evolving environment, we'd love to hear from you.
